metadata.question: Did surface water extent in Keechelus Lake, Washington, decrease between July 2024 and July 2025?

data.raw_code:
<thinking>
1. Search strategy: Use Sentinel-2 SR (COPERNICUS/S2_SR_HARMONIZED) median composites for July 2024 and July 2025 over an ROI that tightly bounds Keechelus Lake (approx). If no images, fallback to Landsat 8/9 SR (USGS C2 L2, merged). Dates: 2024-07-01..2024-08-01 and 2025-07-01..2025-08-01.
2. Masking strategy: For S2, mask QA60 clouds/cirrus. For Landsat, mask QA_PIXEL clouds, shadows, cirrus and scale SR. Compute MNDWI (Green, SWIR1) and classify water with threshold > 0.2. Restrict analysis to areas historically water using JRC Global Surface Water occurrence > 0 to reduce false positives.
3. Logic for valid zero vs null: If image collections are empty after attempts -> C1. If collections exist but valid pixel count in ROI after masking is 0 -> C2. If area result is null/NaN -> C3. Otherwise, compare areas; zero area is valid if computed.
</thinking>

<code>
```javascript
const ee = require('@google/earthengine');
const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7');

async function runAnalysis() {
  // 1. Geometry & Time Definitions
  const roi = ee.Geometry.Polygon([
    [-121.43, 47.23],
    [-121.24, 47.23],
    [-121.24, 47.43],
    [-121.43, 47.43],
    [-121.43, 47.23]
  ]);
  const periodA = {label: '2024-07', start: '2024-07-01', end: '2024-08-01'};
  const periodB = {label: '2025-07', start: '2025-07-01', end: '2025-08-01'};

  // Base mask: restrict to historically water-prone pixels to avoid false positives
  const gsw = ee.Image('JRC/GSW1_4/GlobalSurfaceWater').select('occurrence');
  const baseWaterMask = gsw.gt(0).clip(roi);

  // Helpers
  function maskS2(img) {
    const qa = img.select('QA60');
    const cloudBitMask = 1 << 10;
    const cirrusBitMask = 1 << 11;
    const mask = qa.bitwiseAnd(cloudBitMask).eq(0).and(qa.bitwiseAnd(cirrusBitMask).eq(0));
    return img.updateMask(mask).copyProperties(img, ['system:time_start']);
  }
  function getS2Col(start, end) {
    return ee.ImageCollection('COPERNICUS/S2_SR_HARMONIZED')
      .filterBounds(roi)
      .filterDate(start, end)
      .filter(ee.Filter.lte('CLOUDY_PIXEL_PERCENTAGE', 80))
      .map(maskS2)
      .map(function(img){ return img.clip(roi); });
  }
  function maskLandsatC2(img) {
    const qa = img.select('QA_PIXEL');
    const cloud = qa.bitwiseAnd(1 << 3).eq(0);        // Cloud
    const shadow = qa.bitwiseAnd(1 << 4).eq(0);       // Cloud shadow
    const cirrus = qa.bitwiseAnd(1 << 2).eq(0);       // Cirrus
    return img.updateMask(cloud.and(shadow).and(cirrus)).copyProperties(img, ['system:time_start']);
  }
  function scaleLandsatSR(img) {
    const optical = img.select(['SR_B2','SR_B3','SR_B4','SR_B5','SR_B6','SR_B7'])
                       .multiply(0.0000275).add(-0.2);
    return img.addBands(optical, null, true);
  }
  function getLandsatCol(start, end) {
    const l8 = ee.ImageCollection('LANDSAT/LC08/C02/T1_L2');
    const l9 = ee.ImageCollection('LANDSAT/LC09/C02/T1_L2');
    return l8.merge(l9)
      .filterBounds(roi)
      .filterDate(start, end)
      .filter(ee.Filter.lte('CLOUD_COVER', 80))
      .map(maskLandsatC2)
      .map(scaleLandsatSR)
      .map(function(img){ return img.clip(roi); });
  }
  async function computePeriodStats(period) {
    // Try S2 first
    let source = 'S2';
    let col = getS2Col(period.start, period.end);
    let nImg = await col.size().getInfo();
    if (nImg === 0) {
      // Fallback to Landsat 8/9
      source = 'L8/9';
      col = getLandsatCol(period.start, period.end);
      nImg = await col.size().getInfo();
      if (nImg === 0) {
        return {status: 'C1', msg: `${period.label} Images: 0 (no S2 or Landsat)`};
      }
    }

    const comp = col.median();

    // Determine bands and MNDWI
    let greenBand, swir1Band;
    if (source === 'S2') {
      greenBand = 'B3'; swir1Band = 'B11';
    } else {
      greenBand = 'SR_B3'; swir1Band = 'SR_B6';
    }
    const mndwi = comp.normalizedDifference([greenBand, swir1Band]).rename('MNDWI');

    // Valid pixel counts in base water mask region
    const totalCount = await ee.Image(1).updateMask(baseWaterMask)
      .reduceRegion({
        reducer: ee.Reducer.count(),
        geometry: roi,
        scale: 1000,
        maxPixels: 1e9
      }).get('constant').getInfo();

    const validMask = comp.select(greenBand).mask();
    const validCount = await ee.Image(1).updateMask(baseWaterMask).updateMask(validMask)
      .reduceRegion({
        reducer: ee.Reducer.count(),
        geometry: roi,
        scale: 1000,
        maxPixels: 1e9
      }).get('constant').getInfo();

    if ((totalCount === null) || (totalCount === 0)) {
      return {status: 'C2', msg: `${period.label} No valid base pixels.`};
    }
    if ((validCount === null) || (validCount === 0)) {
      return {status: 'C2', msg: `${period.label} Valid pixels after masking: 0`};
    }

    const cloudPct = (1 - (validCount / totalCount)) * 100.0;

    // Water classification within base mask
    const waterMask = mndwi.gt(0.2).updateMask(baseWaterMask).updateMask(validMask);
    const waterArea_m2 = await ee.Image.pixelArea().updateMask(waterMask)
      .reduceRegion({
        reducer: ee.Reducer.sum(),
        geometry: roi,
        scale: 1000,
        maxPixels: 1e9
      }).get('area').getInfo();

    if (waterArea_m2 === null || isNaN(waterArea_m2)) {
      return {status: 'C3', msg: `${period.label} Water area is null/NaN`};
    }

    const waterArea_km2 = waterArea_m2 / 1e6;

    return {
      status: 'OK',
      label: period.label,
      source: source,
      nImg: nImg,
      validCount: validCount,
      totalCount: totalCount,
      cloudPct: cloudPct,
      area_km2: waterArea_km2
    };
  }

  try {
    console.log('ROI: Keechelus Lake approx, Scale=1000m');

    const statsA = await computePeriodStats(periodA);
    if (statsA.status !== 'OK') {
      console.log(statsA.msg);
      console.log(statsA.status);
      return;
    }
    console.log(`${statsA.label} Source: ${statsA.source}, Images: ${statsA.nImg}, Valid px: ${statsA.validCount}/${statsA.totalCount}, Cloud: ${statsA.cloudPct.toFixed(1)}%`);
    console.log(`${statsA.label} Water area (km2): ${statsA.area_km2.toFixed(3)}`);

    const statsB = await computePeriodStats(periodB);
    if (statsB.status !== 'OK') {
      console.log(statsB.msg);
      console.log(statsB.status);
      return;
    }
    console.log(`${statsB.label} Source: ${statsB.source}, Images: ${statsB.nImg}, Valid px: ${statsB.validCount}/${statsB.totalCount}, Cloud: ${statsB.cloudPct.toFixed(1)}%`);
    console.log(`${statsB.label} Water area (km2): ${statsB.area_km2.toFixed(3)}`);

    const dA = statsB.area_km2 - statsA.area_km2;
    const rel = (dA / (statsA.area_km2 === 0 ? 1 : statsA.area_km2)) * 100.0;
    console.log(`Δ Area (km2): ${dA.toFixed(3)} (${rel.toFixed(1)}%)`);

    // Final decision: decreased if area in 2025 < 2024 with small tolerance
    const tolAbs = 0.05; // km2
    const tolRel = 2.0;  // percent
    const decreased = (statsB.area_km2 < statsA.area_km2) &&
                      ((Math.abs(dA) >= tolAbs) || (Math.abs(rel) >= tolRel));

    if (!isFinite(dA) || !isFinite(rel)) {
      console.log('C3');
      return;
    }

    console.log(decreased ? 'A' : 'B');
  } catch (e) {
    console.log(`Error: ${e}`);
    console.log('D');
  }
}

async function initEE() {
  await new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
    ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject);
  });
  await new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
    ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject);
  });
  await runAnalysis();
}

initEE();
```
